title: Inference of interacting kernel in the mean-field regime
summary: We study the problem of reconstructing interaction kernels in systems of interacting agents from macroscopic measurements when posed as an optimization problem. The reconstruction procedure depends on the formulation of the forward model, which may be given either by a finite-dimensional coupled ODE system tracking individual agent trajectories or by a mean-field PDE describing the evolution of the agent density.
